import hashlib,json,pathlib,zipfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();out=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent;perf=root/'docs/performance'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
verified=[]
for p in sorted(perf.glob('chatgpt-byte-opacity*20261105-evidence.zip')):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(p)as z:
        assert z.testzip()is None
        index=json.loads(z.read('index.json'))
        for name,entry in index['entries'].items():
            b=z.read('blobs/'+entry['sha256']);assert len(b)==entry['bytes']and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==entry['sha256'],name
        for k in z.namelist():
            if k.startswith('blobs/'):assert hashlib.sha256(z.read(k)).hexdigest()==k[6:]
    verified.append(dict(path=str(p.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size))
for name in ['chatgpt-byte-opacity-20261105.json','chatgpt-byte-opacity-refined-20261105.json']:
    d=read(perf/name);assert d['focused']['passed']
final=read(perf/'chatgpt-byte-opacity-production-20261105.json')
assert final['page_instruction_credit']==0 and final['broad_cadence_after']==0 and not final['broad_required']
attempts=[]
for suffix in ['r1','r2']:
    folder=out.parent/('chatgpt-byte-opacity-production-20261105-'+suffix)
    d=read(perf/('chatgpt-byte-opacity-production-'+suffix+'-diagnostic-20261105.json'))
    assert d['identity_stable']and len(d['observations'])==4
    assert all(r['exit']==r['kernel_exit_status']==0 and r['pixels_exact']and r['content_exact']for r in d['observations'])
    vox=[r for r in d['observations']if r['engine']=='vox']
    assert sorted((r['variant'],r['paths']['byte_opacity'])for r in vox)==[('candidate',False),('control',False)]
    for r in vox:
        launch=pathlib.Path(r['pixel_comparison']['actual']).parent/'launch.json'
        text=launch.read_text();assert 'VOX_BYTE_OPACITY_DIAGNOSTICS=1'in text
        assert ('VOX_RETAIN_NORMALIZED_OPACITY_FLOAT=1'in text)==(r['variant']=='control')
    guard=read(folder/'run-guard.json');finalizer=read(folder/'finalize-guard.json')
    assert guard['reason']=='completed'and guard['child_exit_code']==1 and guard['adoption_error']is None and guard['adopted_processes']
    assert finalizer['reason']=='completed'and finalizer['child_exit_code']==0
    attempts.append(dict(attempt=suffix,content_pixel_captures=4,fast_path_observed=False,controller_guard=guard,finalization_guard=finalizer,diagnostic=str((perf/('chatgpt-byte-opacity-production-'+suffix+'-diagnostic-20261105.json')).relative_to(root))))
owned=read(perf/'chatgpt-byte-opacity-refined-20261105.json')['source_hashes']
assert all(sha(root/p)==h for p,h in owned.items())
result=dict(evidence_complete=True,source_hashes=owned,archives=verified,production_attempts=attempts,
    qualification='Both cohorts retain four successful content, bootstrap and unchanged-pixel captures. The candidate marker is absent despite the recorded launch environment enabling it. The eligibility gate rejects both; no matched page cohort is attempted. All native inputs/executable identities remain stable within each separate cohort. Component benefits are retained without page attribution; the Brave target remains unmet.',
    page_instruction_credit=0,broad_cadence_after=0,acceptance=False)
(perf/'chatgpt-byte-opacity-verification-20261105.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(archives_verified=len(verified),valid_render_captures=8,page_eligible=False,page_instruction_credit=0)))
